reduce_sum.basis: woof has atomicAdd on device float. Inputs are multiples of 1/16, so sums do not depend on the order. The accumulate case starts from a non-zero out.

rmsnorm.basis: woof maps __shfl_xor_sync to simd_shuffle with __woof_lane() = simd_prefix_exclusive_sum(1u). The kernel takes its lane from threadIdx.x % 32. Metal does not promise that the two agree. Only a run can say.
